summary_en: Dainichiseika Color & Chemicals will acquire up to 3.0 million shares (4.39% of outstanding shares) for up to 3.864 billion yen via ToSTNeT-3 on September 16, 2026, at the closing price of 1,288 yen on September 15, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On September 15, 2026, Dainichiseika Color & Chemicals' board of directors authorized the acquisition of up to 3.0 million shares of its common stock, representing 4.4% of outstanding shares, for a maximum total amount of 3.864 billion yen. The purchase will be executed via off-hours trading (ToSTNeT-3) on September 16, 2026 at 8:45 AM JST at the closing price of 1,288 yen (including final special quotes) from September 15, 2026. The buy order will be limited to this single trading session only, and there is no guarantee that all or any portion of the authorized purchase will be executed depending on market conditions.

The company is implementing this buyback as part of its shareholder return policy outlined in its three-year Medium-Term Management Plan "Tomorrow's Transformation 2027" announced in June 2024. The acquisition supports the company's strategic objective of improving capital efficiency and enhancing shareholder returns while pursuing mechanistic capital policies. The company has also emphasized the importance of improving ROE and PBR ratios as part of its capital cost and stock price-conscious management approach.
